description_expanded: This top-floor condominium in the Della condo building offers some of the best views overlooking the Alys Beach Town Center. Guests of this beautiful vacation rental will also see some views extending to the Gulf. The spacious balcony with plenty of seating is the perfect spot to view many Alys Beach events in the Amphitheatre below. This condo offers a spacious family room, dining area, kitchen with a large center island and a powder room. The primary bedroom contains a king-sized bed and ensuite bath. The second bedroom offers a queen-size bed with a private bath across the hallway. Parking for this unit is located in one designated space in a parking court behind the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
